Registration name: WEKfunk
Exhibition name: Dick Clark ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, before 2008). Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2008).
Introduced in United States by Bailey Nurseries in 2011 as 'Dick Clark'.
Introduced in United States by Star Roses & Plants (California) in 2011 as 'Dick Clark'.
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2011 as 'Dick Clark'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, pink edges, ages to dark red . Moderate, cinnamon, spice fragrance. 17 to 29 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, very double, borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 5'11" to 6'7" (180 to 200cm). Width: 35" to 41" (90 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower or garden. Prefers full sun. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
